messages.content: Write a polished short scene in modern American English between two adult friends repairing a small disagreement. Let the apology and acceptance feel earned but understated. Use realistic dialogue, pauses, and physical actions. Do not turn the scene into a long emotional explanation. The relationship should be shown through how they handle the disagreement.

“I shouldn’t have said that.”

Jordan kept looking at the sink. “No.”

Alex waited.

“No, you shouldn’t have,” Jordan added.

“I know.”

The faucet ran for another few seconds before Jordan shut it off.

Alex leaned against the counter. “I was frustrated.”

“You were.”

“I took it out on you.”

Jordan dried her hands and folded the towel over the handle. “Yeah.”

Alex nodded. “I’m sorry.”

Jordan finally looked at her. “Okay.”

“Okay?”

“I heard you.”

Alex gave a small laugh. “That’s not exactly forgiveness.”

“No. It’s not.”

“Fair enough.”

Jordan opened the cabinet and took out two plates. “You hungry?”

Alex looked at the plates. “A little.”

“Good.”

“Does this mean I’m allowed in the kitchen again?”

Jordan handed her a plate. “You’re on probation.”

“For how long?”

“Until you stop stealing the good fork.”

Alex smiled. “That could take a while.”

“I know.”

She put the second plate on the counter.

“Glad you’re still here,” Jordan said.

Alex looked at her. “Yeah.”

Neither of them made a bigger thing out of it. They just started making dinner.
